Enum DistanceControlState

State machine states reported by the TF5200 distance control module.

public enum DistanceControlState

Fields

Active = 1

Active in SET_POS mode — axis is tracking the surface position.

ActiveConstDistance = 4

Active in constant-distance mode — axis maintains a fixed gap.

DryrunConstDistance = 6

Dry-run constant-distance mode — no axis motion, for filter evaluation.

DryrunSetPos = 7

Dry-run SET_POS mode — no axis motion, for filter evaluation.

Error = 5

Error state — invalid command transition or position control error.

Freeze = 2

Offset is frozen at its last value; sensor is no longer tracked.

Inactive = 0

Distance control is off; no offset is applied.

TurningOff = 3

Transitional: offset is ramping to zero before returning to Inactive.
